gaps.sentence: There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).

gaps.sentence: I'd sooner ___ at home than go to the party.
The museum charges for entry; ___, under-twenties visit free.
gaps.explanation: 'However' marks the contrast between paying and free.

gaps.sentence: He's the man ___ car was stolen.
gaps.explanation: 'whose' shows possession: the man whose car…

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.
